reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 3 recyclers trading the same material (27% of its feedstock)
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.42x the cost floor)
Certificates sold at 0.47x the market median price
29% of high-value consignments have no e-way bill
17% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
7.9% of purchase invoices are dated on Sundays (typical: 1.4%)

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
